text_block_list.text:
A few months had passed since her debut race.
While conducting our usual training—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Yukino, you doing okay?
Wanna take a quick break?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm okay!
I can still run!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Besides, right now I want to catch up to
City-san as fast as I can!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I see, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's go for one more!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wahya!? Trainer-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing!
It's totally nothing, but still...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

—For someone claiming it's nothing,
she lets out an awfully heavy sigh.
choice_data_list: Shall we take a little break to refresh ourselves?
Want to do something for a change of pace?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: A change of pace? ...You mean like a date?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Really!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Then Maya'll get ready in one minute flat!
It's a date with Trainer, a date☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I wonder what kind of grown-up date
you're gonna take me on~♪

"...And so, we decided to head out for a change of pace.
As for a place that would make her happy—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The end of a date's gotta be at the place
where Maya can sparkle the brightest!
—There really is no other place than that.
(WAAAAAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Is this...
choice_data_list: It's the place where you can shine the brightest
It's a place where you can sparkle brighter than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Do you still feel that way, Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If Maya says, 'Actually, maybe that wasn't it~,'
right now... would you get mad?
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
What's the matter all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, Maya thought that
racing was guaranteed to be thrilling."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"All the girls who run in races
are sparkling bright, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's why I was looking forward to it so much.
Her debut race, and all the others too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But you know, when I actually tried running...
it was just... different.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, just that it's nothing special, really.
Maybe even a little boring.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I know the truth deep down. I know I shouldn't
be saying things like this either. But...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...No matter what, it's just so boring.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

Because what she experienced in the Twinkle Series
was merely debut-level caliber.

Mayano Top Gun simply wasn't satisfied
with this level. In that case,
she just needs to aim for the next summit.

From now on, opportunities to compete against even stronger rivals will come.
There are still races out there she has yet to experience.

"So if the source of your troubles
was that the present felt 'boring'—"
choice_data_list: Let's make things even more fun from now on!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Have fun?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Can I really... do that?
Because Maya's already—
choice_data_list: I'll do my best to make you sparkle!
I'll do my best so you can shine brightly.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-chan.

There must be a way to shine
that only Mayano Top Gun can achieve.

"If I have the privilege of training an Umamusume
as talented as Mayano Top Gun—"

—Preparing a stage where her talent can shine
and finding a way for her to grow uniquely her own—
that is my duty as her trainer.
